definitions.explanation: The act of devoting oneself entirely to a cause, person, or duty, often at the expense of one's own interests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{献身|けんしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To devote oneself to one's family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{献身|けんしん}{的|てき}な⟦{看護|かんご}→看護：13668_kango⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to her devoted nursing care, I was able to recover.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたる⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{献身|けんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{認|みと}められ→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧、⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Their long years of dedication to the local community were recognized, and they received an award.

notes:
FORMS:
{献|けん} (offer, dedicate) + {身|しん} (body, self) = offering oneself.

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as a noun ({献身|けんしん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ) or with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({献身|けんしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧). The adjectival form {献身|けんしん}{的|てき} (devoted, dedicated) is very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {献身|けんしん}{的|てき}な: devoted, dedicated
- {献身|けんしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to devote oneself
- {献身|けんしん}{的|てき}な⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: devoted love
- {献身|けんしん}{的|てき}な⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧: devoted effort
- {献身|けんしん}{的|てき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work devotedly
